text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut race has finally 
arrived. Cheval Grand was extremely 
nervous, her face completely pale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, spurred on by the cheers of her 
childhood friends and the encouragement of 
her Trainer, Cheval Grand gets fired up 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain rises on her debut race, the 
memorable first step of her journey!
